news.title: Welcome to the Toon Valley Alpha!
news.body: The gates are open! Make a Toon, grab some gags and help us find bugs before launch.

news.title: Estates, Gardens and Fishing
news.body: Your estate is ready: plant flowers, rent a cannon, and cast a line in the pond.

news.title: Report a Bug, Earn Bragging Rights
news.body: Spotted something silly? Use "Report an Issue" below and send us the game log from the logs folder.
